title: Behavioral Biases & Market Timing Pitfalls
content: Retail investors frequently underperform market benchmarks due to behavioral traps: 1. Loss Aversion: Panic selling during market corrections. 2. FOMO (Fear Of Missing Out): Buying speculative assets at market peaks. 3. Market Timing Myth: Trying to predict short-term market tops and bottoms. Systematic SIP discipline, diversification across equity index funds, debt, and gold, and long-term holding periods overcome these psychological traps.
